Configuring {integration_title} using YAML is being removed but there was a connection error importing your YAML configuration.

Ensure the EPH Ember cloud is reachable and restart Home Assistant to try again, or remove the `{domain}` climate platform from your `configuration.yaml` and set up the integration through the UI.

deprecated_yaml_import_issue_invalid_aut.description:
Configuring {integration_title} using YAML is being removed but the username or password in your YAML configuration was rejected.

Correct them and restart Home Assistant to try again, or remove the `{domain}` climate platform from your `configuration.yaml` and set up the integration through the UI.
deprecated_yaml_import_issue_invalid_aut.title: The {integration_title} YAML configuration import failed
